context.synopsis: Trump signed an executive order converting approximately 8,000 senior career federal employees into "Schedule Policy/Career" — effectively making them at-will employees who can be fired without cause. Targeted positions include agency directors, CIOs, program managers, regulation writers, attorneys, and senior HR officials. 97% are GS-15 or Senior Leader level. These employees can no longer challenge firings before the Merit Systems Protection Board, and whistleblower complaints would be investigated by their own agency rather than the independent Office of Special Counsel. The culmination of a years-long push first attempted in October 2020, this strips the firewall between political appointees and career civil servants that has protected nonpartisan governance since 1883.
context.rationale: Converting career civil servants to at-will employees destroys the foundational principle of merit-based, nonpartisan federal employment established by the Pendleton Act 143 years ago. Removing whistleblower protections for senior officials who can be fired at will ensures that political loyalty — not competence or integrity — determines who remains in government. This is the spoils system reborn.
